module_summary: AXI-stream Ethernet FCS inserter: a 4-state FSM passes payload, optionally pads to minimum length, then appends four CRC32 bytes from an LFSR child, using a byte counter and skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/PAD/FCS controller selecting output byte source and input ready

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Frame byte counter for padding length and FCS byte selection

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 accumulated over payload; inverted bytes emitted as FCS

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: LFSR child next CRC state loaded into crc_state

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Muxed output byte: payload, pad zero or FCS byte; also CRC input

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables CRC state update on each payload or pad byte

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload byte forwarded to output and CRC

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, deasserted during pad and FCS insertion

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame marker starting pad or FCS insertion

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input bad-frame flag; aborts FCS insertion and propagates error

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream byte including appended FCS

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from skid buffer register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame after last FCS byte

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready advancing pad/FCS states and skid buffer stores

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot valid holding stalled beat

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal beat into output registers

groups.name: FCS insert controller
groups.description: FSM and byte counter sequencing payload, padding and FCS byte emission

groups.name: CRC datapath
groups.description: Output byte mux feeding LFSR CRC32 child and CRC state register

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers decoupling downstream ready

groups.name: Stream interfaces
groups.description: AXI-stream input and output ports plus busy status
